lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a repetitive grid-like spatial distribution posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased luminance intersecting with high-intensity blobs to form a structured coordinate-like pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running above the gill slits, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with lighter pixels on the dorsal side and darker pixels on the ventral side.
